greenhouse:digitalocean98:8275062.text:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you’ll find your place here.  We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world. 
We want people who are passionate about automating large scale networks on the Internet.

We are looking for a Software Engineer (Network Automation) to join the existing network engineering team, working with the infrastructure group. Reporting to the Manager of Networking Infra, the software engineer will be part of a team that is automating and maintaining the DigitalOcean network handling all the traffic from the Internet edge to the hypervisors.  Our networks need to be massively scalable, and enable systems agility, while providing our hundreds of thousands of customers with the most stable platform.  We work with other infrastructure and engineering teams to ensure new products and features have scalable network architectures and will provide the performance our customers require.

If you’re looking for a software engineering role to challenge your skills and be rewarding and fulfilling, while working with top of the line network infrastructure and help build software to manage a large network with huge scaling requirements and modern design, this job is for you.

What You'll Be Doing:

Designing, developing and maintaining software tools/automation for networking infra and systems to help us manage our networks across all of our sites at DO.

Working with networking infrastructure focused engineers to develop/maintain our network automation and monitoring platform

Helping to maintain good code quality by providing guidance during code reviews

Leverage AI coding tools to rapidly prototype and roll out solutions

What We'll Expect From You:

B.Tech./B.E./B.Sc. in Computer Science or equivalent degree

Knowledge of basic networking concepts and either have previous experience or have a strong interest in learning and working on software and tools to automate data center networks.

Knowledge of and demonstrated ability in at least one of the following languages: Go, Python

Familiarity with Linux

Familiarity with CI/CD, containers and/or virtualization, web servers, and databases

Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or the ELK stack is preferred.

Familiarity with automation frameworks (Salt preferred, Ansible)

Good knowledge of code versioning tools such as Git, and accustomed to multi-branch development

Technologies we use:

Programming languages: Python, Go, Bash

Tools: Salt, Ansible, NAPALM, NetBox, Prometheus, Kubernetes, Hasura GraphQL

Technologies and standards: IPFIX, OpenConfig, NETCONF

Network protocols: BGP, MPLS, IS-IS, OSPF

Network hardware: Juniper, Arista 

*This job is located in Hyderabad, India

JR: 2026-8247

#LI-Hybrid

Why You’ll Like Working for DigitalOcean

We innovate with purpose. You’ll be a part of a cutting-edge technology company with an upward trajectory, who are proud to simplify cloud and AI so builders can spend more time creating software that changes the world. As a member of the team, you will be a Shark who thinks big, bold, and scrappy, like an owner with a bias for action and a powerful sense of responsibility for customers, products, employees, and decisions.

We prioritize career development. At DO, you’ll do the best work of your career. You will work with some of the smartest and most interesting people in the industry. We are a high-performance organization that will always challenge you to think big. Our organizational development team will provide you with resources to ensure you keep growing. We provide employees with reimbursement for relevant conferences, training, and education. All employees have access to LinkedIn Learning's 10,000+ courses to support their continued growth and development.

We care about your well-being. Regardless of your location, we will provide you with a competitive array of benefits to support you from our Employee Assistance Program to Local Employee Meetups to flexible time off policy, to name a few. While the philosophy around our benefits is the same worldwide, specific benefits may vary based on local regulations and preferences.

We reward our employees. The salary range for this position is based on market data, relevant years of experience, and skills. You may qualify for a bonus in addition to base salary; bonus amounts are determined based on company and individual performance. We also provide equity compensation to eligible employees, including equity grants upon hire and the option to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Program.

DigitalOcean is an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

Application Limit: You may apply to a maximum of 3 positions within any 180-day period. This policy promotes better role-candidate matching and encourages thoughtful applications where your qualifications align most strongly.

Hardware Engineer

  This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:
   
 Job Family Definition:
 
Designs, analyses, develops, modifies and evaluates electrical/electronic parts, components, sub-systems, algorithms, or integrated circuitry for Routers (access, edge and core) and Ethernet Switches.  Conducts feasibility studies, design margin and validation analyses and empirical testing on new and modified designs. Assists in architecture development and assessment. Evaluates reliability of materials, properties, designs, and techniques used in production. May direct support personnel in the preparation of detailed design, design testing and prototype fabrication.
 
Management Level Definition:
 
Hardware Engineering Team under Networking BU is working on the most leading edge technologies for Routers and Ethernet Switches used in Hyperscale Data Centres for AI, Service Providers, Enterprise Networks. Team is responsible for end-to-end design and development of solutions.
 
Contributions have visible technical impact on a product or major subcomponent.  Applies in-depth professional knowledge and innovative ideas to solve complex problems. Visible contributions improve time-to-market, achieve cost reductions, or satisfy current and future unmet customer needs. Recognized internal authority on key technology area applying innovative principles and ideas. Provides technical leadership for significant project/program work. Leads or participates in cross-functional initiatives and contributes to mentorship and knowledge sharing across the organization.

What you’ll do:
Responsibilities:
·       Owning End-to-End responsibility of designing and delivering the product
·       Working closely with PLM Team, understanding the Market Requirements and coming-up with architecture details
·       Defining architecture, product description details, authoring hardware functional specifications
·       Complete Hardware Design Flow – Schematic Entry, selecting components, working with various teams – eCAD, PCB Layout, SI, Power, Mechanical, Thermal, FPGA
·       Specifying PCB Stack, working with PCB vendors, supply chain and manufacturing teams
·       Working with CM and/or ODM and taking the product through complete lifecycle – proto to production
·       Hardware Bring-up, testing, supporting various test teams – EDVT, MDVT, EMC, HALT, SI, IEEE
·       Working closely with Diagnostic Software Team for design validation and manufacturing testing.
·       Working with Software, Software Test Teams, debugging complex system issues.·    
   Develops organization-wide architectures and methodologies for electrical hardware design and development across multiple platforms and organizations within the Global Business Unit.
·       Identifies and evaluates new technologies, innovations, and outsourced development partner relationships for alignment with technology roadmap and business value; creates plans for integration and update into architecture.  
·       Reviews and evaluates designs and project activities for compliance with technology and development guidelines and standards; integrates suggestions, updates, and innovations into   overall architecture and leads platform architecture process across business.
·       Leverages recognized domain expertise, business acumen, and experience to influence decisions of executive business leadership, outsourced development partners, and industry standards groups.
·       Provides guidance and mentoring to less- experienced staff members to set an example of electrical hardware design and development innovation and excellence.

 
What you need to bring:
Education and Experience Required:
 
·       Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering.
·       Typically 6+ years experience
 
Knowledge and Skills:
·       Using electrical design tools and software packages.
·       Excellent analytical and problem solving skills.
·       Experience in designing hardware using high speed serial interface with speed of 50G, 100G with NRZ, PAM4
·       Experience with x86 CPU architecture
·       Experience designing high layer count boards(18+) including 50G+ signals, and advanced PCB manufacturing technologies
·       Experience working with multi-phase DC/DC’s for high current, high transient loads
·       Experience working with high speed interfaces, such as DDR4, DDR5, LPDDR, PCIe Gen3, PCIe Gen4, NVMe SSD
·       Experience in overall architecture of electronic hardware for products and solutions.
·       Designing and integrating electronic components, integrated circuitry, and algorithms into overall architecture.
·       Evaluating, proposing, and selecting forms of empirical analysis, modeling and testing methodologies to validate component, circuit, and hardware designs and thermal/emissions     management to be used across the organization.
·       History of innovation with multiple patents in the field of electronics packaging.
·       Excellent written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language.
·       Ability to effectively communicate product architectures, design proposals and negotiate options at business unit and executive levels.

Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

What We Can Offer You:
Health & Wellbeing
We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development
We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion
We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Let's Stay Connected:

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

Company Description

Job Description
Software Engineer, Pune
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Mid Software Engineer based in Pune/Chennai. In this role, you will take end-to-end ownership of scalable backend architectures, web scraping pipelines, and core web applications. You will balance data extraction engineering with robust backend development using Python, PHP and PostgreSQL. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and love solving complex data challenges, this role is for you. 
Responsibilities 
Data Extraction & Web Scraping 
Build scalable web crawlers to harvest structured and unstructured web data using custom and enterprise frameworks. 
Manage dynamic content extraction using advanced browser automation tools for JavaScript-heavy, AJAX, and infinite-scroll sites. 
Optimize crawling performance through concurrent execution, asynchronous programming, and container multi-threading. 
Backend & Application Engineering 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend microservices using Python and PHP. 
Build web applications and custom internal tools using the PHP CodeIgniter framework. 
Design Python based RESTful APIs to ensure seamless data integration across cross-functional platforms. 
Database Management & Operations 
Write efficient, optimized SQL queries and manage schema design within PostgreSQL. 
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex production issues to maintain system stability. 
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including Product, QA, DevOps, and other engineering units.
Qualifications
Must Have Experience: 3+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
Web Scraping: Deep proficiency with Python parsing packages (Scrapy, BeautifulSoup, LXML, Requests). 
Browser Automation: Hands-on experience handling browser execution via Selenium, Playwright, or Pyppeteer. 
PHP: Strong development experience in PHP and the CodeIgniter framework. 
Database: Solid understanding of PostgreSQL database schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning. 
Architecture: Strong foundation in designing Microservices and building robust RESTful APIs. 
Soft Skills: Ownership: Ability to take a project from concept to delivery independently. 
Collaboration: Strong communication skills to align with remote and local cross-functional teams. 
Agility: A proactive mindset that thrives in fast-paced, continuous-improvement environments. 
Nice to Have Cloud & DevOps: Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and CI/CD pipelines. 
Containerization: Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes orchestration. 
Tooling: Experience with Git version control and logging, monitoring, and observability tools. 
Methodology: Familiarity working within Agile/Scrum frameworks using JIRA
